components/ai/chat/conversation.tsx.name: Chat scroll follower
components/ai/chat/conversation.tsx.description: Scrolls the chat to follow a streaming answer until the reader scrolls up, and offers a jump-to-end button; Turn wraps one exchange.

components/ai/chat/index.tsx.name: AI chat panel
components/ai/chat/index.tsx.description: Holds the chat state provider, the panel, header, messages, sources and search parts, and the input whose draft survives reloads.

components/ai/chat/markdown.tsx.name: Answer markdown renderer
components/ai/chat/markdown.tsx.description: Renders an answer with remark and hast-util-to-jsx-runtime, re-rendering only the last block while streaming and mending unclosed syntax.

components/ai/chat/open.tsx.name: Chat open state
components/ai/chat/open.tsx.description: Provides the open flag, Ctrl+/ and Escape shortcuts, the pending askAI prompt and the floating trigger button, separate from chat state.

components/ai/layout.tsx.name: Layouts with AI chat
components/ai/layout.tsx.description: Wraps the Fumadocs notebook and home layouts with the chat provider, trigger and a next/dynamic panel loaded on first open.

components/ai/search.tsx.name: Chat transport and panel
components/ai/search.tsx.description: Binds useChat to /api/chat with the last ten messages, maps HTTP errors to plain text, logs PostHog events and renders Inkeep source links.

components/inkeep/inkeep-search.tsx.name: Inkeep search dialog
components/inkeep/inkeep-search.tsx.description: Replaces the Fumadocs SearchDialog with Inkeep's modal, loaded via next/dynamic, and hands Ask AI queries to the chat panel.
